Serving Woodbridge

Wraps for Woodbridge businesses and drivers.

Woodbridge has a lot of family-run contractors, landscapers, renovators and trades businesses, and for many of them a lettered pickup or van is the main advertising they do. We lay the design out on your exact vehicle so the name and phone number read clearly on Highway 7 and in the driveways where you work.

We regularly work with customers from Woodbridge village, Sonoma Heights, Vellore Village, East Woodbridge and the Pine Valley Drive corridor.

Getting to our shop

Woodbridge is in west Vaughan; from most of Woodbridge it’s usually 10–20 minutes to our shop along Highway 7 or Langstaff Road.

FAQ

Questions from Woodbridge customers.

Also serving: Vaughan · Concord · Maple · King City · Etobicoke · Brampton · Toronto · Richmond Hill · Markham · Thornhill · Mississauga · North York · Newmarket · Aurora.

Do you wrap vehicles from Woodbridge?
Yes. Woodbridge is in west Vaughan; from most of Woodbridge it’s usually 10–20 minutes to our shop along Highway 7 or Langstaff Road. Design, printing and installation all happen in our Vaughan shop.
How much does a vehicle wrap cost?
A full printed wrap starts at about $2,800 for a car, $3,950 for a Transit-size van and $5,800 for a box truck, before tax. Lettering and partial wraps cost less. Use our online estimator for a price on your exact vehicle.
How long does a wrap take?
Design and proofing usually take a few days. Most installs take one to three days depending on the vehicle and coverage, and we book the drop-off so your vehicle is out of service for as little time as possible.
How long does a commercial wrap last?
With cast film and laminate, expect around 5–7 years on vertical panels in Ontario weather, and 3–5 years on roofs and hoods. Our workmanship warranty covers lifting and peeling for 5 years.
Do you design the wrap?
Yes. Our in-house designers build the layout on your vehicle’s template for a $250 design deposit that is credited to the wrap when you go ahead. You can also send your own print-ready artwork.

Ready to wrap in Woodbridge?

Send a photo of the vehicle and your logo — we’ll come back with a layout and a price within one business day.
